messages:
Emily: FYI assembling release plan for tonight change window 23:00-01:00 PT. Services: api v3.2.1, runtime kernel v4.9, console schema v2.0.3, router header-split. Need ordering and rollback triggers. Who's able to be oncall + watch metrics? :eyes:
Jordan: I can watch runtime + router. Runtime needs the kernel bump; I'd prefer runtime first so API can be pinned to the new runtime. Any objections to runtime -> router -> api -> console?
Sam: Console has a small DB reindex in the migration, so last makes sense. Also we should pin API to model-version=rv1 until router header gating is fully live.
Emily: Proposed order: runtime -> router -> api -> console. Canary slices: runtime 10% for 8m, router 10% for 10m, api 5% for 15m, console 5% for 20m. Rollback triggers: 5xx rate + latency p95 > 350ms sustained for 3m rolling window.
Jordan: Agreed. How do we pin the API? Use `redwoodctl pin api --version 3.2.1 --until 2026-03-22T02:00`
Sam: Add a hold condition: if console migration in staging shows >2 failing checks, hold console. Also prepare router fallback: `routerctl rollback-route --tag stable`
Emily: I'll create the release ticket and notes. Draft coming in ~10m, will include KV eviction notes and runtime kernel caveats.
Launchbot: LAUNCHBOT: Release window locked for 2026-03-21T23:00:00-01:00. Lock token: lh-9b3. To start staged release run: `/launch start --ticket LH-932 --order runtime,router,api,console --canary-slices 10,10,5,5`
Ops-Oncall: I'll be on watch from 22:30 -> 02:30. I'll mute noisy alerts and keep critical 5xx/latency unmuted. Pager: @ops-oncall
Jordan: I'll run the runtime rollout. Sam take router? Emily you handle API + console handoff.
Sam: Taking router. Note: router has header gating flag that requires console to set `header-write=true` before we flip traffic. Coordinate the feature flag flip during the API step.
Emily: Plan: after router canary passes, flip console `header-write` to true, then run API canary with model pin. I'll add this to the runbook.
Jordan: Rollback playbook (high level): runtime rollback = revert kernel build + drain nodes; router rollback = set weights away from new route using `routerctl set-weight`; api rollback = revert pin `redwoodctl pin api --version 3.1.7`; console rollback = reverse DB migration + maintenance page.
Launchbot: LAUNCHBOT: Preflight checks passed: infra quotas OK, smoke tests green (runtime smoke: OK, router smoke: OK, api smoke: OK, console smoke: OK).
Emily: Two asks before we go: (1) release notes link when ready, (2) copy telemetry dashboards for the run so ops doesn't look at stale charts. Sam can you confirm dashboard copy?
Sam: Will copy dashboards to `dash/rel-LH-932` and share link in the ticket.
Ops-Oncall: I'll create a Grafana mute for non-critical alerts for the window, leaving critical 5xx and p95 latency alerts active.
Jordan: I'll queue the runtime canary start at 23:00: `redwoodctl release start runtime --canary 10% --duration 8m`
Emily: Posting release notes draft: https://redwood.internal/release/LH-932. Please review. If no objections by 22:45 I'll mark ready and start.
Nina: :eyes: Quick question — does the console DB migration require a backup? Reindex takes ~10m and is not reversible.
Emily: Good catch. Ops scheduled a backup at 23:30 and will verify before console step. We'll hold console until backup is confirmed.
Jordan: :rotating_light: If we see runtime GC spike or kernel-related CPU jitter after the bump, we pause the rollout and rollback runtime immediately.
Emily: Agreed. If runtime pauses, we unpin API and keep router on stable; no further steps until we greenlight.
Launchbot: LAUNCHBOT: Scheduling entry created: `/launch schedule LH-932 2026-03-21T23:00` — notification to @here at 22:50.
Emily: :thumbsup: Thanks all. I'll update the ticket with the final runbook and lock. See you in the window.
